matches.title: Genoa vs Südtirol
matches.description: Watch Genoa vs Sudtirol highlights and goals from Coppa Italia on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on September 15, 2026. The Coppa Italia delivered another evening of high drama on September 15, 2026, as Genoa faced off against a disciplined Südtirol side. It was a match defined by tactical patience, defensive resilience, and a dramatic conclusion that rewarded the persistence of the home supporters. A Tight and Tactical First Half From the opening whistle, Südtirol established a solid defensive structure that proved difficult for Genoa to break down. The first half was characterized by intense midfield battles and limited clear-cut chances for either side. Despite Genoa 's attempts to dictate the tempo, the visitors remained compact, ensuring that the scoreline remained level. As the referee blew for half-time at 45+1 minutes, both teams headed to the tunnels with the match still searching for its first major breakthrough. Substitutions Alter the Dynamic The second half saw both managers turn to their benches in an attempt to spark some offensive creativity. Giacomo Stabile replaced Andrea Giorgini at the break, and as the hour mark passed, Genoa introduced a wave of experience with Stephan El Shaarawy , Kevin Zeroli , and Lorenzo Colombo . The influx of fresh legs increased the pressure on the Südtirol backline, though the visitors continued to defend gallantly, making their own tactical changes by bringing on Salvatore Molina and Alvin Okoro to maintain their energy levels. In the 80th minute, a pivotal substitution occurred that would ultimately decide the fate of the tie. Johan Vasquez entered the fray, replacing Sebastian Otoa . This move added a new dimension to Genoa 's approach during the final stages of the game, as they pushed forward with renewed urgency to avoid the uncertainty of extra time. Vasquez Becomes the Late Hero The decisive moment arrived in the 87th minute, just as the game seemed destined for an additional thirty minutes. David Puczka delivered a pinpoint assist, finding Johan Vasquez in a dangerous position. The substitute made no mistake, firing the ball home to give Genoa the lead. The late goal left Südtirol with very little time to respond, and despite a final substitution to bring on Bjarki Steinn Bjarkason , they could not find an equalizer. Genoa held on to secure their progression, thanks to a moment of clinical finishing in the dying embers of the match.
